item.content:encoded:
I really do enjoy this a lot, for a series based on chatbots and with a fraction of the text an average tale uses, you made me care about which direction a picture of a bird was looking. The story is, as some other people have said, a little cliché with how Glacon has gone (honestly, even the hyper logical robot who just needs emotions/personality to be more rounded is pretty cliché) but it's presented in a way that's entertaining and interesting.

One gripe I have is the acres and acres of blank white space on the page. It's just that I don't have a solution to that that would make sense, so I sort of relegate it to a gripe.

Overall, this is a really interesting presentation of subject matter and characters that entertains and is a lot of fun +1
